product_overview: Student Planner is a full‑stack academic planner web application that helps university students manage semesters, courses and grades, calculate CGPA, plan study hours, analyze grade scenarios, and visualize academic performance. It provides both authenticated semester/course management and public planning tools (CGPA planner, study planner, grade analyzer).
core_goals: Enable authenticated users to create, update, and track semesters and courses and compute per‑semester GPA and cumulative CGPA.
Provide public planning utilities (CGPA calculation, study hours planner, grade analyzer) that can be used without logging in.
Visualize academic progress (GPA trends, grade distributions, credit loads) and enable side‑by‑side scenario comparison.
Protect user data with JWT authentication and optional Google OAuth, enforce validation and rate limits, and support export of plans/results.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Register and log in using email/password with JWT authentication or Google OAuth 2.0; retrieve and update authenticated profile.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with {name,email,password} -> Receive 201 with created user id -> POST /api/auth/login with {email,password} -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/auth/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user profile

GET /api/auth/google -> Receive 302 redirect to Google OAuth consent -> GET /api/auth/google/callback with OAuth code -> Receive 302 redirect back with session or JWT -> GET /api/auth/profile with returned token/cookie -> Receive 200 with profile
POST /api/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive 401 with authentication error
POST /api/auth/register with existing email -> Receive 400 with validation error (email already in use)

features.name: Semester Management
features.description: Authenticated users can create, list, view, update, and delete semesters (each semester has name, level, status and computed GPA).
user_flows: POST /api/semesters with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name,level,status} -> Receive 201 with semester object including id -> GET /api/semesters with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with list containing created semester -> GET /api/semesters/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with semester details

PUT /api/semesters/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name,level,status} -> Receive 200 with updated semester -> GET /api/semesters/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with updated data
DELETE /api/semesters/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 204 -> GET /api/semesters/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 404 (not found)
POST /api/semesters with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid level (e.g., 999) -> Receive 422 validation error

features.name: Course Management
features.description: Manage courses within a semester: add, update, and delete courses (each course has name, credit units 1–6, and grade).
user_flows: POST /api/semesters/:semesterId/courses with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name,credits,grade} -> Receive 201 with course object -> PUT /api/semesters/courses/:courseId with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name,credits,grade} -> Receive 200 with updated course -> GET /api/semesters/:semesterId with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with semester containing updated course list
DELETE /api/semesters/courses/:courseId with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 204 -> GET /api/semesters/courses/:courseId with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 404
POST /api/semesters/:semesterId/courses with Authorization: Bearer <token> and credits outside 1–6 -> Receive 422 validation error
PUT /api/semesters/courses/:courseId with Authorization: Bearer <token> for non-existent course -> Receive 404

features.name: CGPA Planner
features.description: Public endpoint to calculate the required semester GPA to reach a target cumulative GPA given current CGPA, completed credits, and planned upcoming courses.
user_flows: POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa with body {currentCGPA,completedCredits,targetCGPA,courses:[{name,credits}]} -> Receive 200 with {requiredGPA,feasible,breakdown}
POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa with targetCGPA or inputs missing -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa with a case where requiredGPA > 4.0 -> Receive 200 with {requiredGPA: >4.0, feasible:false, breakdown} (feasibility warning)

features.name: Study Hours Planner
features.description: Public planner that recommends study hours per course based on credit units, difficulty, weekly available hours, and target GPA.
user_flows: POST /api/planner/plan-study with body {targetGPA,availableHours,courses:[{name,credits,difficulty}]} -> Receive 200 with {schedule:[{course,recommendedHours}], totalHours}
POST /api/planner/plan-study with availableHours insufficient (e.g., 0) -> Receive 400 with explanation that available hours are insufficient
POST /api/planner/plan-study with malformed course entries -> Receive 422 validation error

features.name: Grade Analyzer
features.description: Public tool that analyzes grade combinations and recommends minimum grades per course (greedy algorithm) to achieve a target semester GPA.
user_flows: POST /api/planner/analyze-grades with body {targetGPA,courses:[{name,credits}]} -> Receive 200 with {recommendations:[{course,minimumGrade,gradePoints}], feasible}
POST /api/planner/analyze-grades with impossible target (e.g., target requires >A in all courses) -> Receive 200 with recommendations and feasible:false (or explicit infeasible warning)
POST /api/planner/analyze-grades with missing course data -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated overview page that shows current CGPA, target CGPA, counts and recent semesters for quick navigation.
user_flows: GET /api/auth/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user profile including target CGPA -> GET /api/semesters with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with semesters list -> Client displays totals and recent semesters
GET /api/auth/profile with expired or missing token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Data Visualization
features.description: Charts for GPA trend, grade distribution, and credit load per semester for authenticated users.
user_flows: GET /api/semesters with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with list of semesters and summary GPAs -> GET /api/semesters/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with course list and grades -> Client renders line, pie, and bar charts
GET /api/semesters with Authorization: Bearer <token> when token invalid -> Receive 401 and charts show auth error state

features.name: Comparison Tool
features.description: Compare up to 5 GPA planning scenarios side‑by‑side; each scenario runs the CGPA calculation independently and best scenario is highlighted.
user_flows: POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa with scenario A body -> Receive 200 with requiredGPA A -> POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa with scenario B body -> Receive 200 with requiredGPA B -> POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa with scenario C body -> Receive 200 with requiredGPA C -> Client compares results and highlights lowest requiredGPA
POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa with malformed scenario -> Receive 400 validation error; client displays error for that scenario and allows correction

features.name: Export
features.description: Export study plans, planner results and comparisons to PDF or CSV (client-side export preferred; optional server export API supported).
user_flows: POST /api/planner/plan-study with body to generate schedule -> Receive 200 with schedule -> POST /api/exports with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {data:<schedule>, format:'pdf' } -> Receive 201 with {exportId,downloadUrl} -> GET /api/exports/:exportId/download with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with file stream
POST /api/exports with unsupported format (e.g., format:'exe') -> Receive 415 unsupported media type or 400 with format error
POST /api/planner/calculate-gpa -> Receive 200 and client generates PDF/CSV locally via jsPDF/PapaParse without server export

features.name: Profile Management
features.description: Authenticated endpoints to view and update user profile (name, email, university, department, target CGPA).
user_flows: GET /api/auth/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with profile {name,email,university,department,targetCGPA} -> PUT /api/auth/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {name,university,department,targetCGPA} -> Receive 200 with updated profile
PUT /api/auth/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid email format -> Receive 422 validation error
GET /api/auth/profile without token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
